<thought>Analyzing the spectrum, a clear M, M+1, M+2, … series is observed with the M+1 peak (~10 % of the base peak) indicating the presence of carbon (13C). The other isotopic patterns (e.g., a strong M‑2 peak) do not match the characteristic 3:1 (Cl) or ~1:1 (Br) ratios, nor the low‑intensity signatures of S, O, N, etc. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
